allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Moksh Ornaments Limited has informed the Exchange Regarding clarification regarding an inadvertent typographical error in the Explanatory Statement pursuant pertaining to the preferential allotment.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Moksh Ornaments Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'the date of closure of the Rights Issue which was scheduled to close on Friday, January 10, 2025, has now been extended till next Friday i.e., January 17, 2025, by Rights Issue Committee in its Meeting held today i.e., January 9,2025'.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Moksh Ornaments Limited has informed the Exchange that the date of closure of the Rights Issue which was scheduled to close on Friday, January 10, 2025, has now been extended till next Friday i.e., January 17, 2025, by Rights Issue Committee in its Meeting held today i.e., January 9,2025

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Moksh Ornaments Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on December 14, 2024, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 14 : 23, i.e 14 Equity Shares for every 23 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 15 per share.
